item.title: ‘Students are everything for me’: Franklin Tech Superintendent Richard Martin to retire - Athol Daily News
item.description: Franklin County Technical School Superintendent Richard Martin will be retiring on June 30 after 17 years at the school, during which he developed the animal science and aviation maintenance technology programs, secured $11.4 million in grant funding and emphasized student success through relational leadership.

item.title: ‘Who’s your momma?’: A vibrant dish for the transition to spring: Maque Choux - Athol Daily News

item.title: Mahar to vote on $16.1M budget - Athol Daily News
item.description: The Ralph C. Mahar Regional School District School Committee will vote on the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of $15.98 million on Thursday, April 9, which involves an increase of 0.97% over the current fiscal year.

item.title: Warwick named Green Ribbon School for sustainability strides - Athol Daily News
item.description: Warwick Community School has earned the title of "Green Ribbon School" for its commitment to protecting the environment, with every class completing nature-centered projects and the school using solar power and an electric bus.

item.title: Athol community seeks volunteers for annual Green Clean event - Athol Daily News
item.description: Green Clean Athol is hosting its annual community cleanup on April 18th, with new organizers Kim LaFleur, Johanna Lawlor-Moore and Heather Heath, hoping to attract more volunteers to help pick up trash from Athol streets.
